statement_made: Indy is the perfect fit. I’m ready to join that front and cause some havoc in the backfield.
event_description: First public reaction after being selected by the Indianapolis Colts in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.

statement_made: We’ve been watching Tyleik for a long time. His ability to move at that size is rare, and he fits exactly what we do defensively.
event_description: Colts GM explaining the selection of Tyleik Williams during the post-draft presser.

statement_made: Two-way or one-way, I’m here to be a playmaker for the Falcons. Atlanta, let’s get to work.
event_description: Addressing the media after being selected in the top 10 by the Atlanta Falcons.

statement_made: I’m excited to have a weapon like Carnell. The young guys keep me feeling young. Can’t wait to throw him the rock.
event_description: Discussing the addition of Carnell Tate to the Titans' receiving corps.

statement_made: The wait was worth it. Seatbelt on, Seattle. We’re going to have some fun.
event_description: Reacting to being selected by the Seattle Seahawks on Day 1 of the draft.

statement_made: Shedeur has a poise you don't see often. He’s been under the spotlight his whole life, and he’s ready for this stage.
event_description: Seahawks GM justifying the pick of Shedeur Sanders as the new face of the franchise.

statement_made: Philly is a wide receiver's dream. Playing alongside Devonta and AJ is going to be a masterclass every day.
event_description: Discussing his fit with the Eagles after being selected in the first round.

statement_made: Cleveland is getting a dawg. I’m ready to roam that secondary and make plays.
event_description: First public statement after being drafted by the Cleveland Browns in the first round.

statement_made: Malaki is one of the most instinctive safeties we’ve evaluated in years. He’s a day-one impact player for us.
event_description: Browns GM recapping the first-round selection of Malaki Starks.

statement_made: New England is a legacy franchise. I’m honored to be part of the group tasked with protecting the future.
event_description: Reacting to being selected as the Patriots' top offensive lineman in the 2026 draft.

statement_made: The Chargers got a playmaker. Jim, let’s go win a trophy.
event_description: A brief, confident message to HC Jim Harbaugh after being drafted in the top 5.

statement_made: Luther is a yards-after-catch machine. He fits the physical profile we’re looking for at receiver.
event_description: Chargers GM evaluating the addition of Luther Burden III to the roster.

statement_made: DC is getting a game-changer. I’m ready to hunt quarterbacks in the NFC East.
event_description: Reflecting on his draft selection by the Washington Commanders.

statement_made: Harold is a Swiss Army knife. We can use him in so many different ways to create pressure.
event_description: Commanders HC discussing the defensive utility of rookie Harold Perkins Jr.

statement_made: Lockdown in the 412. Ready to keep the tradition alive in Pittsburgh.
event_description: First social media post after being drafted by the Pittsburgh Steelers.

statement_made: Benjamin is a professional corner. He’s technically sound and highly competitive—a perfect Steeler.
event_description: Coach Tomlin praising the maturity of rookie corner Benjamin Morrison.

statement_made: Chicago is a city of legends. I’m here to make sure Caleb stays clean and we bring winning football back to Soldier Field.
event_description: Addressing the Bears' fans after being drafted in the first round.

statement_made: Drafting Kelvin is huge. You can never have enough protection, and I’m ready to get to work with him.
event_description: Welcoming rookie tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. to the Bears.

statement_made: The Motor City just got a whole lot heavier. Let’s hunt.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted by the Detroit Lions in the late first round.

statement_made: Deone is a mountain of a man who can move. He adds a dimension to our defensive line we were missing.
event_description: Lions GM explaining the selection of Deone Walker.
